map.镗削（镗刀/镗杆/精度）控制 使用指南: Boring (Boring Bar/Bar Length/Accuracy) Control User Guide
map.镗削工艺控制工具按镗刀、镗杆与精度要求估算切削参数与形位公差，适合孔加工工艺编制: The boring process control tool estimates cutting parameters and geometric tolerances from the boring bar, bar length, and accuracy requirements, fitting hole-machining process planning and accuracy control.
map.镗孔尺寸与形位公差（圆度、圆柱度）控制。: Control of hole size and geometric tolerances (roundness, cylindricity).
map.镗杆长径比引发的振颤规避。: Avoiding chatter caused by a high length-to-diameter ratio of the boring bar.
map.：精镗 IT7 级、孔径 50mm：公差约 ±0.012mm，需分粗镗留 0.3: : finish boring to IT7 with a 50 mm bore: tolerance about ±0.012 mm, which needs a rough-boring pass leaving 0.3–0.5 mm before finish boring to size.
map.：孔径 50mm、镗杆悬伸 300mm：长径比 = 300÷50 = 6，易振颤: : bore 50 mm with a 300 mm bar overhang: the length-to-diameter ratio = 300÷50 = 6, which chatters easily; add guidance or shorten the overhang, otherwise lower the speed to improve surface quality.
map.粗镗精镗余量怎么分？: How Should the Rough and Finish Boring Allowances Be Split?
map.粗镗去大余量保效率，留 0.3–0.5mm 给精镗保证尺寸与粗糙度；余量过大精镗: Rough boring takes the large allowance to stay efficient, leaving 0.3–0.5 mm for finish boring to hold size and roughness; too large an overloads finish boring, too small is hard to correct.
map.镗杆为什么怕长径比大？: Why Are Long Slender Boring Bars a Problem?
map.长径比大刚性差、易弯曲振颤，孔易呈腰鼓或波纹；用粗镗杆、导向套、低转速大进给抑制: A large length-to-diameter ratio means poor rigidity and easy bending and chatter, so the hole tends to become waisted or wavy; counter it with a fatter bar, a guide bushing, and low speed with high feed.
